description:
Sales Intern (Placement)
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
Who We Are:
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
Job Description:
Build your commercial skills and start your career in technology sales with HPE’s UK & Ireland Partner & Ecosystem team. You’ll work alongside our leaders, Partner Business Managers, Distribution Business Managers and Sales Specialists, supporting the businesses that bring HPE technology to customers. From turning sales data into insights to supporting partner meetings and events, you’ll contribute to day-to-day priorities while learning how a partner-led sales business operates.
What you’ll nee d
Placement eligibility: You must be in the second year of a four-year degree that requires, or offers the option of, a one-year industrial placement in the third year.
You should be expected to achieve at least a 2:1.
Availability and right to work: You must be eligible to work in the UK and available for a 13-month placement starting July 2027
Initiative and sound judgement: You can work independently, find solutions and recognise when to ask for help or guidance.
Organisation and adaptability: You manage your time effectively, take a structured approach and prioritise competing tasks in a fast-paced sales environment.
Clear communication: You can communicate confidently with colleagues, partners and distributors by phone, email and face to face.
Collaboration: You enjoy working with others and proactively embrace opportunities to contribute.
Attention to detail: You take care to complete work accurately and check the quality of your output.
Microsoft Office skills: You have basic experience using Microsoft Office, including Outlook and Excel.
Travel: You are prepared to travel across the UK & Ireland when required.
What you’ll do
Keep the business moving: Support the day-to-day operations of the UK & Ireland Partner & Ecosystem team, helping colleagues coordinate priorities and deliver work accurately and on time.
Turn data into insight: Develop and maintain reports using Power BI and Salesforce, analysing sales data and identifying trends to support planning and track progress.
Support sales forecasting: Build and update the fortnightly forecast pack, working with the relevant Sales Manager to bring together information for the forecasting process.
Help shape business discussions: Prepare presentations and supporting materials for meetings, including Quarterly Business Reviews, bringing together insights, progress and priorities.
Engage with partners and distributors: Take part in internal and external meetings at HPE and partner offices, gaining first-hand exposure to commercial relationships.
Bring partner activities to life: Help organise and deliver events, run activities and represent HPE at sales floor days and enablement sessions.
Make processes easier to navigate: Act as a point of contact for partner and distributor questions about HPE tools and processes.
Keep audiences informed: Create newsletters, emails and other communications for internal teams, partners and distributors.
Coordinate programmes responsibly: Help manage programmes, including incentives, and support associated governance activities.
Broaden your experience: Contribute to ad hoc projects across marketing, communications, operations and the wider HPE sales business.
What you’ll gain
A practical understanding of how HPE works with partners and distributors across the UK & Ireland.
Hands-on experience in sales analysis, forecasting, business reviews and programme coordination.
Opportunities to develop your communication and presentation skills through team, partner and distributor engagement.
Exposure to different business functions, with opportunities to develop both professional and technical skills.

Recruitment Fraud Alert
We have become aware of an increase in fraudulent recruitment activities in which individuals impersonate our company or authorized recruitment agencies to offer fake employment opportunities. These scams may occur through false websites, emails, social media, or chat-based applications and often aim to obtain personal information or money. Please note that Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), its direct and indirect subsidiaries and affiliated companies, and its authorized recruitment agencies/vendors will never charge a candidate a registration fee, hiring fee, or any other fee in connection with its recruitment and hiring process. We also never request personal information such as back account details, Social Security numbers, or national IDs via social media or chat applications.
All legitimate job opportunities will come through official company channels, and candidates are responsible for verifying the credentials of any third party claiming to represent the company. Any reliance on fraudulent communication is at the individual’s own risk, and HPE disclaims legal liability for any resulting damages. If you suspect recruitment fraud, do not share personal information or make any payments and report the incident to your local authorities immediately.
